5º de Primaria · Inglés

Prepositions of place and time

Ficha para imprimir
123456
1

Pregunta de arranquePiensa 30 segundos antes de seguir

En castellano decimos «en la mesa», «en abril» y «el lunes». En inglés, ¿«en» siempre es in?

Escribe o di en voz alta tu respuesta. Después .

No. Las preposiciones inglesas son más precisas. Para lugares, in es «dentro» (in the box) y on es «encima» (on the table). Para el tiempo usamos in con meses y años (in April), on con días (on Monday) y at con horas (at five o'clock).

2

Aprende9 bloques cortos

Where is it?

Prepositions of place tell us where something is. The basic ones are: in (dentro de): «The pencil is in the pencil case.» on (encima de, tocando): «The book is on the desk.» under (debajo de): «The cat is under the bed.»

We ask with Where is…? or Where are…?: «Where are my trainers?» «They're under the sofa!» En castellano: «en» puede ser in o on. Pregúntate: ¿está dentro o encima?

Next to, between, behind…

More prepositions of place: next to (al lado de): «Lucas sits next to Emma.» between (entre dos cosas): «The bank is between the bakery and the pharmacy.» behind (detrás de): «The garden is behind the house.» in front of (delante de): «There's a tree in front of my window.»

opposite (enfrente de, al otro lado): «The school is opposite the park.» near (cerca de): «I live near the beach.» Ojo: in front of es «delante de», no «enfrente».

Describing my bedroom

Prepositions are perfect to describe a room. «My bed is next to the window. There's a rug on the floor and a box of toys under the bed. My desk is opposite the door. My books are on the shelf, between the lamp and the plant. My clothes are in the wardrobe… well, some of them are on the chair!»

Use There is (one) and There are (more than one): «There are two posters on the wall.» «There is a clock above the door.» above = encima, sin tocar.

Giving directions

In a town we use prepositions to give directions. Useful phrases: go straight on (sigue recto), turn left (gira a la izquierda), turn right (a la derecha), take the first street on the left, cross the road (cruza la calle).

«Excuse me, where's the library?» «Go straight on and turn right. The library is next to the post office, opposite the park.» «Thank you!» Remember to be polite: start with Excuse me and finish with Thank you.

When? In, on and at

Prepositions of time tell us when. The three most important are in, on and at. Think of a pyramid. In is for big periods: months, seasons, years and centuries: in May, in winter, in 2015, in the 21st century.

On is for days and dates: on Monday, on my birthday, on 3rd June, on Christmas Day. At is for exact times: at seven o'clock, at half past four, at midnight, and also at the weekend and at night.

Vídeo: In, on, at: preposiciones de tiempo para niños · Inglés para niños con Mr Pea (YouTube) · 749 mil visualizaciones

Parts of the day

Be careful with the parts of the day. We say in the morning, in the afternoon and in the evening, but at night. «I have English in the morning.» «We go to the park in the afternoon.» «Owls hunt at night.»

If we add a day, we use on: «on Monday morning», «on Saturday night». And with this, next, last, every we don't use any preposition: «I'll see you next Friday», «We play every Tuesday», «I went last summer».

Time and place together

Many sentences have both: where and when. The usual order in English is: place first, then time. «I play football in the park on Saturdays.» «We had lunch at my grandma's at two o'clock.» «My cousin was born in Seville in 2016.»

Truco: «¿Dónde? ¿Cuándo?», en ese orden. También podemos poner el tiempo al principio para destacarlo: «On Saturdays, I play football in the park».

Reading: the school trip

Read the note from the teacher: «Dear families, our school trip to the Natural Park is on Friday 14th May. We meet at the school gate at half past eight in the morning. The bus stops in front of the gym. At the park, we will have lunch under the big trees, next to the river. The information centre is opposite the car park. We come back at five o'clock in the afternoon. Please put a hat and a water bottle in your child's bag.»

When is the trip? Where does the bus stop? Where will they have lunch?

Let's practise: hide and find

Play «Where's the rubber?» One student hides a rubber in the classroom while another waits outside. Then the class gives clues: «It's near the board. It's under something. It's between two books.»

Second game: «My week». Tell your partner three activities with in, on, at: «I have swimming on Tuesday at six. In summer I go to the village.» Repaso: lugar: in, on, under, next to, between, behind, in front of, opposite. Tiempo: in (mes, año), on (día), at (hora).

Ejemplos resueltos

Ejemplo 1. Complete: «The keys are ___ my bag.» (dentro)

  1. Dentro de algo: in.

Resultado: The keys are in my bag.

Ejemplo 2. Complete with in, on or at: «My birthday is ___ March, ___ the 9th.»

  1. Mes: in.
  2. Fecha concreta: on.

Resultado: My birthday is in March, on the 9th.

Ejemplo 3. Order the sentence: «at 10 / to the cinema / we went»

  1. Primero lugar, después tiempo.

Resultado: We went to the cinema at 10.

Errores típicos

  • Traducir siempre «en» por in: «in the table» → «on the table».
  • Confundir in front of (delante) con opposite (enfrente).
  • Usar in con los días: «in Monday» → «on Monday».
  • Decir «in the night» → «at night».
  • Poner preposición con next, last, every: «on next Friday» → «next Friday».

Ejercicios

Hazlos en tu cuaderno y después abre la solución.

  1. Complete: «The milk is ___ the fridge.»

    Ver solución
    in.

  2. Complete: «The picture is ___ the wall.»

    Ver solución
    on.

  3. Complete: «The dog sleeps ___ the table.» (debajo)

    Ver solución
    under.

  4. Complete: «The B is ___ the A and the C.»

    Ver solución
    between.

  5. Complete with in, on or at: «___ summer», «___ Sunday», «___ 6 o'clock».

    Ver solución
    in summer, on Sunday, at 6 o'clock.

  6. Complete: «I read ___ night and I run ___ the morning.»

    Ver solución
    at night, in the morning.

  7. Correct: «I was born on 2015 in July.»

    Ver solución
    I was born in July 2015. / I was born in 2015.

  8. Translate: «La farmacia está enfrente del colegio.»

    Ver solución
    The pharmacy is opposite the school.

  9. Give directions: go up the street and turn left.

    Ver solución
    Go straight on and turn left.

  10. Describe your desk in three sentences.

    Ver solución
    Model answer: My pencil case is on the desk. My bag is under the desk. The lamp is next to the books.

Para familias

  • Esconded un objeto en casa y dad pistas en inglés con preposiciones.
  • Al hacer la agenda de la semana, decid cada actividad con on + día y at + hora.
  • Repasad juntos las tarjetas del paso 6 dos minutos al día durante una semana.

Para profesores

Saberes: Descripción de lugares y ubicación de objetos; preposiciones de lugar y de tiempo; indicaciones sencillas (Lengua Extranjera) (RD 157/2022, tercer ciclo de Primaria).

  • Plano de la ciudad en la pizarra para dar indicaciones.
  • Juego de esconder la goma con pistas.
  • Pirámide de in, on, at con tarjetas de expresiones de tiempo.

Qué vas a aprender

  • Say where things are with prepositions of place (dónde está algo)
  • Use in, on, under, next to, between, behind, in front of and opposite
  • Say when things happen with in, on and at
  • Give simple directions and describe a room

Palabras clave

preposition · in · on · under · next to · between · behind · in front of · opposite · at · in + month · on + day · at + time

Tiempo

50 minutos hoy + 2 minutos en cada repaso
